  • Watermelon %5
  • Pear %4
  • Cucumber %2
  • Apple Candy %1
  • Koolada 3 Drops per 10ml

This 'wasted space' is a common misconception. The container layout simply displaces the whitespace from the middle to the outside edges. The amount of wasted space is, therefore, almost exactly the same, but all of the text and controls are together in the middle so you don't have to shoot your cursor across the page to access different buttons and controls.
